checks.fix: Under eight minutes the test was not shown; past forty the wait was not cut.
Four seconds of nothing outside gameplay is somebody waiting on a model. Cut it.
A horizontal video gets the platform's captions; burned ones cover the screen being shown.

rubric.ask: Do the first ten seconds show both results as a trailer (bars, label, music) before the greeting?
rubric.fix: Pick the best moment of each result and the line that sums the comparison up, and place the teaser.

rubric.ask: Is anything said that the rest of the video contradicts, such as a result being ready when it is built again later?
rubric.fix: Cut the claim; keep only what the video goes on to show.

rubric.ask: Does a failed or discarded attempt appear, or anything about redoing it?
rubric.fix: Join the end of the news straight to the attempt that was kept.

rubric.ask: Does the jump card name the time at which the test really starts?
rubric.fix: Run the jump-card recipe again; it reads the time off the timeline.

rubric.ask: Is any chat message read out or answered during the wait?
rubric.fix: Keep only the progress marks of the wait.

rubric.ask: Is any sentence heard twice in a row, a retake left in?
Does the video end on the grades and the goodbye?
rubric.fix: End after the goodbye that follows the verdict.
